comment: One owner per area (the owner's decision of 2026-09-27 on #1198; the team of two, the owner's word of 2026-09-30). An area is a path or a folder ending in '/'; the longest match names the owner; a path in no area is free. The Boss owns every area and is the arbiter: a pull request's author is the owner whose session link its body carries, and one from any other session carries the line 'HANDED BY Boss: <files>' in its body, the arbiter's hand-over covering any area (tools/ownership.py). The advisor writes nothing and owns no area.
